title: Operationalizing Company Objectives into Team Roadmaps: Alignment Templates & Escalation Runbook
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Create a repeatable, lightweight playbook and artifacts that translate company-level OKRs into explicit team roadmap commitments. Deliverables: alignment templates (objectives -> measurable outcomes -> milestones), an operational escalation runbook for blocked cross-functional dependencies, a dependency matrix format for the roadmap, and a two-quarter pilot with three product + eng squads.
acceptance_criteria: Alignment template created and published to Confluence with example filled for 3 pilot initiatives
Escalation runbook documented with SLAs for cross-org dependency resolution and RACI assignments
Dependency matrix CSV schema and import script for roadmap tool validated by Platform and Eng
Pilot completed with 3 squads and retrospective logged with at least 3 actionable changes to cadence or ownership
Leadership sign-off that templates are ready for Org-wide roll-out
milestones: 2025-01-17: Draft alignment template and RACI canvas (v0.1)
2025-01-24: Review with Eng Leads & Design; incorporate feedback (v0.2)
2025-02-07: Publish pilot materials and kickoff with squads
2025-03-01: Leadership review and rollout plan approval
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Pilot): 3 squads (Runtime, Console, Dedicated) run through alignment templates during planning cycle
Phase 2 (Revise): Incorporate pilot feedback, automate dependency matrix ingestion into roadmap tool
Phase 3 (Enable): Run two training sessions for PMs and Eng managers and publish playbook
Phase 4 (Adopt): Mandate template use for company-level initiatives in next quarterly planning; track compliance via audits
